title: mpeg-ts-analyzer JSON report v2
description: Schema for --format json. Objects permit additive fields and status strings permit additive lowercase values within schema version 2.

status.description: Current values: complete, programs_listed, incomplete, failed.

error.description: Human-readable error detail; not a stable matching interface.

transport_errors.description: Packets with transport_error_indicator set, over every packet of the range. Present whenever the analysis ran (status complete).

scrambled_packets.description: Packets with a non-zero transport_scrambling_control, over every packet of the range. Present whenever the analysis ran (status complete).

pes_headers.description: PES header checks of every elementary stream of the selected program. Present whenever the analysis ran (status complete).

pts_repetition.description: Intervals between PES packets carrying a PTS on each video and audio stream of the selected program. Present whenever the analysis ran (status complete).

psi_transitions.description: PAT and PMT version changes applied during the analysis, in stream order. Absent when no change was applied. programs describes the layout at the start of the analysis.

reason.description: Stable machine-readable reason code. Current value: pmt_parse_failed.

error.description: Human-readable error detail; not a stable matching interface.

service.description: The program's service from the SDT actual (table_id 0x42) whose service_id equals program_number; absent when the stream has no SDT or the SDT does not list the program. The fields come from the service_descriptor and are absent without one. Each name is either decoded text or, when its DVB character table is not supported, the raw bytes including the table selector as lowercase hex.

reason.description: Human-readable skip explanation; not a stable matching interface.

sync.description: TS synchronization of the analyzed packets: packet boundaries without the sync byte 0x47 and the realignment after each. Offsets are absolute byte offsets in the input.

status.description: Current values: ok, recovered, lost. lost means the analysis stopped at an unrecovered loss (top-level status incomplete, reason sync_lost).

reason.description: Present for lost: why no alignment was found. Human-readable; not a stable matching interface.

required_sync_bytes.description: Consecutive packets, one packet size apart, that must start with the sync byte to accept a new alignment.

max_resync_scan_bytes.description: How far after a lost boundary a new alignment may start.

skipped_bytes.description: Bytes skipped by the recovered losses; they were not analyzed.

max_skipped_bytes.description: The largest span skipped by one recovered loss.

max_skipped_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the loss with the largest skipped span.

unrecovered_offset_bytes.description: The lost boundary where the analysis stopped; present for lost.

trailing_partial_packet_bytes.description: Size of an incomplete packet at the end of the input; 0 when there is none. Not a loss of synchronization.

label.description: Role of the PID in the applied layouts: PAT, PMT, PCR, video, audio, stream_type 0xNN, null for 0x1fff, or unknown.

excluded_packet_count.description: Packets of this PID whose payload or PCR the analysis would have read and left out instead.

first_offset_bytes.description: Byte offset of the PID's first affected packet (for M2TS, of its TP_extra_header).

status.description: Current values: ok (no affected packet), affected (affected packets, none carrying data the analysis reads), data_excluded (data of at least one affected packet was left out of the analysis).

first_offset_bytes.description: Byte offset of the first affected packet; absent when packet_count is 0.

pids.description: Affected PIDs in numeric order; empty when packet_count is 0.

kind.description: Current values: truncated, bad_start_code, bad_flags, inconsistent_length, bad_marker_bits.

first_offset_bytes.description: Byte offset of the packet that starts the first PES with this problem (for M2TS, of its TP_extra_header).

stream_type.description: The last stream_type the PMT announced for the PID.

label.description: video, audio or stream_type 0xNN, from stream_type.

status.description: Current values: ok (every checked header is valid), errors (at least one header failed a check), insufficient_data (no header was checked).

reason.description: Present with insufficient_data. Current values: no_pes, untrusted_payload, incomplete_headers.

unchecked_count.description: PES packets whose header was not complete when the data ended (untrusted payload, a PMT change or the end of the range); not counted as errors.

first_error_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the first malformed header; absent when error_count is 0.

errors.description: Header problems found, in the order of kind listed above.

status.description: Current values: ok (every checked header is valid), errors (at least one header failed a check), insufficient_data (no header was checked).

reason.description: Present with insufficient_data. Current values: no_pes, untrusted_payload, incomplete_headers.

unchecked_count.description: PES packets whose header was not complete when the data ended (untrusted payload, a PMT change or the end of the range); not counted as errors.

first_error_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the first malformed header; absent when error_count is 0.

errors.description: Header problems found, in the order of kind listed above.

pids.description: Every elementary stream of the analyzed programs, by program_number and PID.

stream_type.description: The last stream_type the PMT announced for the PID.

label.description: video, audio or stream_type 0xNN, from stream_type.

status.description: Current values: ok (at least one interval measured, none above the limit), ng (an interval exceeded the limit), insufficient_data (nothing could be measured), skipped (the stream_type is not a video or audio type).

reason.description: Present with insufficient_data or skipped. Current values: no_pes, untrusted_payload, malformed_headers, no_pcr_timing, no_pts, single_pts, not_video_or_audio; for the totals also no_video_or_audio.

pts_count.description: Valid PES headers carrying a PTS.

interval_count.description: Intervals measured between two PES packets carrying a PTS.

max_interval_ms.description: Largest interval: measured, or a lower bound above the limit (PES packets without a PTS for that long). Absent when there is none.

max_interval_start_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that starts the largest interval.

max_interval_end_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that ends the largest interval.

first_exceeded_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that ends the first interval above the limit; absent when exceeded_count is 0.

limit_ms.description: 700: ISO/IEC 13818-1 clause 2.7.4 and ETSI TR 101 290 indicator 2.5 (PTS_error).

status.description: Current values: ok (at least one interval measured, none above the limit), ng (an interval exceeded the limit), insufficient_data (nothing could be measured), skipped (the stream_type is not a video or audio type).

reason.description: Present with insufficient_data or skipped. Current values: no_pes, untrusted_payload, malformed_headers, no_pcr_timing, no_pts, single_pts, not_video_or_audio; for the totals also no_video_or_audio.

pts_count.description: Valid PES headers carrying a PTS.

interval_count.description: Intervals measured between two PES packets carrying a PTS.

max_interval_ms.description: Largest interval: measured, or a lower bound above the limit (PES packets without a PTS for that long). Absent when there is none.

max_interval_start_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that starts the largest interval.

max_interval_end_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that ends the largest interval.

first_exceeded_offset_bytes.description: Offset of the PES packet that ends the first interval above the limit; absent when exceeded_count is 0.

pids.description: Every elementary stream of the analyzed programs, by program_number and PID.

kind.description: Current values: backward, wraparound, forward_gap, dts_after_pts.

pcrJitter.description: PCR jitter: an estimate, the delivery assessment that decides whether the estimate can be judged, and the resulting status.

status.description: Current values: ok, warning, ng (judged against ±500 ns / ±25 µs, only when delivery.assessment is constant), not_assessable (an estimate exists but delivery is not constant), skipped (no estimate could be made). skipped takes precedence over not_assessable.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for skipped and not_assessable; not a stable matching interface.

pcrJitterEstimate.description: The jitter estimated with one model. The value fields are present when the estimate was computed (status other than skipped).

model.description: Current values: byte_position (the expected PCR is interpolated from its neighbors by byte position, which assumes constant delivery).

pcr_pids.description: PIDs the PCRs were taken from, in order of first appearance.

observations.description: PCRs with a neighbor on both sides in their segment, each giving one jitter value.

max_abs_jitter_ns.description: Largest |jitter|, the value the status is judged on.

pcrDelivery.description: Whether the stream supports the constant-delivery premise of the byte_position model, from its multiplex rate over windows of at least window_seconds of PCR time.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the assessment; not a stable matching interface.

average_rate_bps.description: Multiplex rate over all windows (transport-stream bytes, all PIDs). Present when window_count > 0.

max_deviation_percent.description: Largest deviation of a window rate from average_rate_bps. Present when window_count >= 2.

plausible_jitter_limit_ns.description: A larger estimated |jitter| makes the delivery variable.

reason.description: Human-readable skip explanation; not a stable matching interface.

pids.description: Selected-program PIDs included in program totals.

null_pid.description: Mux-wide NULL stuffing, excluded from program totals.

psiTransition.description: One applied PAT or PMT version change. The new layout applies to the packets after offset_bytes. PAT changes carry programs, programs_added, programs_removed and pmt_pid_changes; PMT changes carry program_number, previous_pcr_pid, pcr_pid, elementary_streams, elementary_streams_added, elementary_streams_removed and stream_type_changes.

offset_bytes.description: Offset of the packet that completed the new table.

pid.description: PID that carried the new table.

version.description: Equal to previous_version only for the first PMT read from a PMT PID the program moved to, when its content differs.

programs.description: Every program of the new PAT.

elementary_streams.description: Every elementary stream of the new PMT.

elementary_streams_removed.description: Removed streams with their previous stream_type.
